description.value: Kamloops Paintball Games is a long-running outdoor paintball park located on Harper Mountain Road, about 20 minutes from downtown Kamloops, offering woodsball, speedball, and low-impact formats for a wide age range. Run by three experienced paintball operators with over 100 combined years in the BC paintball industry, the park hosts public walk-on days as well as private group bookings for birthdays, corporate events, and school outings. A touring cyclist looking for an active half-day excursion off the main route could make this a destination stop, though it sits well off the highway on a mountain road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a legitimate, active outdoor paintball park at 3355 Harper Mountain Road, Kamloops, BC, with a 2026 season underway. The website provides phone and address not present in OSM tags; the OSM website URL matches the fetched site. None of the WWC required criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) or optional amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.

Location on Harper Mountain Road is a notable detour from typical cycling routes; accessibility by bike not confirmed.
Website notes cash-only payment at the field, which may be relevant for touring cyclists without cash.
